sources.provenance: Reporting only: is_copy, caption_swapped, original_level and all source fields never enter methods.

rule.name: flag_rep
rule.flag: beta(record) < frozen t, strictly; equality is unflagged
rule.representative: Highest CLIPScore among unflagged records; tie record_id ascending. No unflagged record => no representative, all held.
rule.export: Use unchanged pair_action from frozen scores and parsed.decision; call local export_cluster with complete original ids, new representative, complete actions. All flagged records must be held. Preserve full ids so incident mismatch effects are identical to policy b.
invariants: Unflagged original representative => exactly identical to policy b, all three states.
Retained, pending(held), deleted disjoint and exhaustive.
Missing required frozen pair judgment stops; no new pair inference.
rule.coverage: Unchanged COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN coverage_export iterative=True. Deleted in CLIPScore descending/ID ascending order; complete retained IDs sorted; only valid covered=true deletes, else retain and extend references; held never checked or rescued. Reuse predictions only on identical COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN text_key, invoke local text-only Qwen only for new keys.

benchmark.A1: CPU: independently rebuild COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN b, COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN b_cov, apply flag_rep and flag_rep_cov on multi-record clusters; count flagged representatives/all-flagged clusters per partition; per-cluster full-state differences; frozen200clusters/953records audit fate and paper-number comparison.

A2.report: Report max abs q/beta differences, then singleton flags by partition and M-source counts; singleton flags never alter A1.
A2.reference: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN original validation6132 CLIPScore and valid-q midrank references, frozen, never refit.
A2.record_prompt:
Caption: {caption}
Does this caption correctly describe the image? Answer with yes or no.

inference.logprob_meaning: Top20 token candidates at the first generated position

downstream.B1: Rebuild CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN b/b_cov with exact per-ID identity before constructing new sets. Reuse frozen fusion, t, pair verdicts, groups and subsets. Report count/images/assets/copies/swapped/removed-original/per-image histogram plus flagged representatives moved to held.

methods.clipscore_fr: Remove lowest CLIPScore, tie ID ascending; count equals b_fr_cov deleted+held
methods.random_fr: Random(20261106).sample from sorted record IDs; same removed count

B2.reuse: CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN no_dedup,keep_one,semdedup,clean,b,b_cov,clipscore,random:80 existing train/evaluation receipts, no retraining except named gate.
B2.environment: CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN caption-env, GPT2/CLIP assets, annotations and evaluation code; FLAG_REP_RUN owns all outputs/cache paths.
B2.settings: Identical CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN ClipCap initialization, batch, optimizer, schedule, decoding and test membership. Background process durable progress; resume exact checkpoint/stream state and completed runs.

B3.correction: BY separately across all231 and all63 p values; never per-metric/tail corrections.
B3.direction: Higher better except CHAIR_i/s; oriented differences positive=better.
B3.flags: P iff adjusted two-sided and greater <.05; N iff adjusted two-sided and less <.05; else S. No extra performance pass line.
B3.report: Means +/- sample SD, each comparison raw and oriented mean difference, count better among10 subsets, all raw/adjusted p, P/N/S counts. Clean reference excluded from comparisons.

caption_downstream.identity: Exact set of retained record IDs for each historical training set

time.project_before_start: Actual elapsed plus measured pilot estimate of all remaining GPU work; >14 stops, no subset reduction authorized.

gates.failure_policy: Persist failing gate evidence and elapsed time, stop dependent stages and report all unexecuted results as null; never reconcile independently computed values toward user estimates.

operations.gpu_preflight: After acquiring flock, record nvidia-smi before loading model.

known_index_scope: Current-status/RESEARCH_LINE dated snapshot still describes downstream as unexecuted/unproven; CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN named completed receipts are the authorized input to FLAG_REP_RUN, not a paper claim update. No index or paper edits in this task.
